name: Loge
source: Loge is a mystery even to me. I do not recall summoning him. He claims to be a guide, helping mortals when they are 'stumped'. Was I really stumped? Why is he here?
translation: Loge is a mystery even to me. I do not recall summoning him. He claims to be a guide, helping mortals when they are 'stumped'. Was I really stumped? Why is he here?
